seo.title: RCS for businesses in Sweden | rcsdirekt.se
seo.description: Send RCS from the web or through an API, with images, buttons and a verified sender. From 0.316 SEK per message and no monthly fee.

hero.title: RCS for businesses
hero.description: Reach customers with your name, logo and buttons right in their messaging app. Send from the web or through the API and pay per message.

fordelar.heading: Five reasons to choose RCS
fordelar.intro: This gets simpler for both you and the customer when the message is sent as RCS.

items.title: The customer sees it is you
items.copy: Company name, logo and a blue checkmark are shown instead of an unknown number. The sender is verified before it is allowed to send.

items.title: Reply with one tap
items.copy: The customer confirms, reschedules or picks an option right in the message, and the reply comes back to you.

items.title: Show what it is about
items.copy: Images, video and several cards to swipe between in the same message, so the customer sees the offer before clicking through.

items.title: You see what happens
items.copy: The reports show whether the message was delivered and read, and which buttons customers have tapped.

items.title: No new app
items.copy: The message lands in the phone's regular messaging app: Google Messages on Android and Messages on iPhone from iOS 18.

jamforelse.heading: What RCS can do that SMS cannot
jamforelse.intro: An SMS is text from a number. RCS arrives in the same app but with your logo, a verified sender, images and buttons. For the customer it feels more like a small app in the thread than an SMS.

rows.label: Read receipts
rows.rcs: Read, if the recipient allows it

rows.label: Unsubscribing
rows.sms: Reply STOP or use a link
rows.rcs: Button, STOP or in the app

vagar.heading: Platform
vagar.intro: If you want to build a campaign yourself, you do it in the browser. If you want your systems to send automatically, you connect the API. The sender and the price are the same.

items.title: Web
items.copy: Log in and create the campaign right in the browser. Upload recipients, add images, text and buttons, preview and send. No technical knowledge is required.

items.title: API
items.copy: Connect RCS to your own systems, for example e-commerce, booking systems or CRM, through a REST API and webhooks. Order confirmations, reminders and offers are then sent automatically when something happens on your side.

pris.heading: Pricing
pris.intro: You pay for what you send. The price depends on the type of message and which operator the recipient has. It costs nothing to start and there is no lock-in period.

blogg.heading: Guides and news about RCS
blogg.intro: Everything from what RCS is to how the API and webhooks work, with sources.

kontakt.heading: Talk to us
kontakt.intro: Tell us a little about what you want to send. We will get back to you and help with the sender, setup and integration.
